rationale.conceptual: The method (transfer matrix) is established but not trivial to implement correctly for this specific triangular lattice with second- and third-neighbour exclusions. It requires careful handling of the lattice mapping, exclusion constraints, state enumeration, and numerical differentiation to compute compressibility. The mathematics involves eigenvalues of non-trivial matrices and thermodynamic relations, placing it above a textbook operation but below a novel research-grade algorithm.

All steps use standard Python libraries (numpy, scipy) and produce CSV outputs. There is no complex environment setup, external data acquisition, or multi-tool orchestration. The flow is linear and manageable.
